name: Rich text
description: A standalone block of formatted text with an optional heading, for brand stories, policies and care notes. For dated stories with a byline, use Article.

fields.name: Heading
fields.helpText: Rendered as the h2. Without one the block has no landmark.

fields.name: Body
fields.helpText: Paragraphs, headings, lists, a quote, inline code and links. No tables, images or embeds — use Article for those.

fields.name: Alignment
fields.helpText: left is the default. content + left becomes a split from 64rem.
